PortfolioHolding.title: PortfolioHolding
PortfolioHolding.description: Represents a stock or asset holding in a user's investment portfolio.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol of the stock or asset (e.g. AAPL, NVDA).

companyName.description: Full display name of the company or asset.

shares.description: Number of shares or units held (> 0).

avgBuyPrice.description: Average purchase price per share in USD (> 0).

sector.description: Market sector or category (e.g. Technology, Finance, ETF, Crypto).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when holding was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when holding was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: Represents a stock symbol tracked on the user's real-time watchlist with optional price alert.

companyName.description: Full display name of the company.

targetAlertPrice.description: Target price alert threshold in USD (0 if no alert).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when added to watchlist (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

EmiPlan.title: EmiPlan
EmiPlan.description: Represents a saved EMI and loan amortization calculation scenario.

title.description: User-defined label for the loan plan.

monthlyPrepayment.description: Optional recurring monthly extra principal payment.

totalInterest.description: Calculated total interest payable over the loan life.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when plan was saved (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when plan was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/holdings/{holdingId}.description: Stores a user's portfolio stock holdings.

/users/{userId}/watchlist/{itemId}.description: Stores a user's watched stock symbols and target price alerts.

/users/{userId}/emi_plans/{planId}.description: Stores a user's saved EMI loan calculation scenarios.
